# Wrenchli

> Wrenchli is a free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform for vehicle owners across the United States, providing likely causes, urgency levels, and fair cost ranges before they visit a repair shop.

Wrenchli helps vehicle owners understand what is likely wrong with their car before visiting a repair shop. Consumers describe their vehicle's symptoms, and Wrenchli's assessment returns a structured report including possible causes with probability scores, urgency levels (immediate, soon, schedule, monitor), estimated cost ranges, and questions to ask a mechanic.

Wrenchli is operated by Wrenchli, Inc., a Delaware corporation founded by Gerrod Parchmon. The symptom assessment is live nationally and always free.

Wrenchli is not a licensed mechanic and does not provide professional diagnostic services. All assessments are informational symptom analyses intended to help consumers have more informed conversations with qualified automotive technicians.

## Core pages

- [Vehicle symptom assessment](https://wrenchli.net): Free AI-powered assessment of vehicle symptoms. No account required. Takes about a minute. Returns likely causes, urgency, cost range, and questions to ask a mechanic.
- [About Wrenchli](https://wrenchli.net/about): Company background, founder, mission, and the information asymmetry problem Wrenchli addresses.
- [For repair shops](https://wrenchli.net/for-shops): Wrenchli's shop program is currently on pause.
- [Garage](https://wrenchli.net/garage): Free vehicle garage with saved assessments, recall alerts, and vehicle history.

## Safety policy

- DIY guidance is shown only when it is safe: urgency of monitor or schedule, and easy or moderate difficulty.
- DIY guidance is never shown for brakes, steering, airbags, or fuel systems. These always show "Shop Required."
- Wrenchli does not replace a qualified automotive technician.

## Content library

- [Blog](https://wrenchli.net/blog): Educational articles covering vehicle symptoms, OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes, and maintenance guides.
- [Check engine light: What P0420 means](https://wrenchli.net/blog/check-engine-light-p0420): Complete guide to the P0420 diagnostic trouble code, common causes, and repair cost ranges.

## Business model

- Free for consumers: the symptom assessment and the garage are free.
- Revenue comes from partners whose products help consumers: parts suppliers and repair financing. Repair financing is on the way.
- Wrenchli never sells consumer data.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://wrenchli.net/privacy): How Wrenchli handles consumer data and vehicle information. VIN is optional. Consumer data is never sold.
- [Warranty guide](https://wrenchli.net/warranty-guide): Manufacturer warranty reference for common vehicle makes and model years.

## Canonical definitions

Wrenchli: A free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform serving vehicle owners across the United States, operated by Wrenchli, Inc.

Symptom assessment: Wrenchli's core service. An AI-driven analysis of vehicle symptoms that returns likely causes with probability scores, urgency levels, and cost ranges. Distinct from professional diagnosis, which requires a qualified automotive technician with physical access to the vehicle.

Urgency levels: Wrenchli classifies repair urgency as immediate (safety risk, do not drive), soon (address within 1 to 2 weeks), schedule (plan a shop visit), or monitor (watch for changes).

Shop Required: Wrenchli's designation for repairs that must be performed by a qualified professional. DIY guidance is never provided for these repairs, including all brake, steering, airbag, and fuel system work.

## Geographic coverage

The symptom assessment is available to any vehicle owner in the United States. Shop matching is not currently offered.
